product.name: Onlook Visual Editor for React
product.description: A desktop application that allows users to visually edit React websites or web applications and synchronizes changes back to the source code in real-time.

product.name: Onlook AI for Frontend
product.description: An AI-powered feature within Onlook that assists users in building, designing, and experimenting with React frontend interfaces through natural language prompts.

product.name: Onlook Visual Editor for Shadcn
product.description: A free, open-source visual editor tailored for editing React websites built with the Shadcn component library and styled with Tailwind CSS, enabling real-time code synchronization.
